description: Answer, for a goal, whether money **set aside** (promised to it but still inside the bank) is still there. A set-aside amount nobody has confirmed for more than 90 days is the one that is asked about; `goal_projection` lists them. `still_there: true` records today against them so they are not asked about again for 90 days. `false` withdraws them from the goal, with the reason written, so the balance stops counting money that is gone. Several goals in one call. **Dry-runs by default**; the document is copied to a timestamped .bak first.

commit.description: Default false. False previews; true writes.

goals.description: One entry per goal. Up to 60 in a call.

goal.description: The goal, by id or by name.

still_there.description: True if the money is still set aside, false if it is gone.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.

name: settle_set_aside
title: Is it still set aside?
